name: Brewshift
summary: A café staff app: drag-and-drop rota across sites, time off, a PIN clock-in kiosk and pay
about: An eight-page app for cafés and shift teams with several sites, in bold café colours. Plan the week by dragging shifts between people and days while clashes, hours and pay update, watch a coffee cup fill with the labour budget, approve time off, clock staff in on a PIN kiosk and run monthly pay with payslips.
how: Pick a café in the top bar (or All cafés) and open a page from the pill menu; on a phone use the menu button.
On Rota, drag a shift to another person or day (hold Alt to copy), click a slot to add one, or focus a shift and press M to move it.
Red shifts are clashes: overlap, too little rest, time off or a missing skill. Hover one to see why; totals and the budget cup update.
Use Copy last week, Auto-fill open shifts, Clear and Publish to finish the week.
On Clock, type PIN 1234 on the kiosk to clock in and again to clock out; attendance shows late arrivals and no-shows.
On Time off and Pay, approve requests, adjust pay, approve and pay the run, and open any payslip.
